We need to create DAO classes. We have schema definitions. Need to write 5 DAO files and __init__.py. Use prepared statements. Use BatchStatement LOGGED for multi-table writes except counters. For counters, separate batch. Use cassandra-driver. Let's inspect schema to know columns.

Tables:

title_by_id: title_id uuid PK, title text, kind text, release_year int, genres set<text>, synopsis text, duration_minutes int, episodes_count int.

titles_by_genre: genre text PK1, release_year int, title_id uuid, title text, kind text. clustering order release_year DESC, title_id ASC.

user_by_id: user_id uuid PK, email text, username text, created_at timestamp.

reviews_by_title: title_id uuid PK1, created_at timestamp, user_id uuid, rating int, comment text, username text. clustering order created_at DESC, user_id ASC.

reviews_by_user: user_id uuid PK1, created_at timestamp, title_id uuid, rating int, comment text, title text. clustering order created_at DESC, title_id ASC.

watch_history_by_user: user_id uuid PK1, watched_at timestamp, title_id uuid, title text, duration_watched_seconds int, completed boolean. clustering order watched_at DESC, title_id ASC.

title_stats: title_id uuid PK1, view_count counter, rating_sum counter, rating_count counter.

daily_views_by_title: view_date date PK1, title_id uuid, view_count counter.

We can use a batch for all inserts (non-counter). Use batch = BatchStatement(consistency_level=ConsistencyLevel.QUORUM?) but not necessary. Use session.execute_batch? We'll use session.execute(batch). Use batch.add(prepared, params). For each genre.

- get(title_id): execute select title_by_id where title_id = ?. Return Title dataclass or None.
